applicable_when: The output store tl.store(out_ptr2 + (r0_2 + 128*x3 + 2048*x0 + 1048576*x4), ...) is severely uncoalesced. Within a warp, threads differ in xindex (and thus x0 = xindex % 256), so consecutive threads access out_ptr2 at stride 2048 floats (8192 bytes) — one cache line per thread, 32 cache lines per warp transaction. NCU confirms only 1.0 of 32 bytes per sector are utilized (1/32 efficiency). The fix is to swap the tile layout so that the R0 (reduction) dimension varies across threads within a block (making the store stride-1 per thread), while the X dimension varies across blocks. This makes consecutive threads write consecutive r0_2 values, achieving full coalescing on the output store.
